purpose: Runtime proof ledger for no-compromise custom faction law activation packets. This file gates movement from diagnostics/planning into gameplay implementation.
validationState: Static-validated June 16 by tools/release_port/check_custom_law_no_compromise_static.py. Updated June 18 with live bridge metadata proof for selected packet surfaces; gameplayAllowed remains false until runtime ordering and mutation semantics are proven.
rules: Every packet referenced by custom_law_targets.json must have exactly one proof entry.
gameplayAllowed must remain false until runtime evidence proves the exact consuming hook context, active law/rank, and native mutation surface required by the packet.
Static decompilation evidence may support a packet, but it cannot set gameplayAllowed=true by itself.
Do not replace unproven packets with donor effects or broad fallback rows.
When gameplayAllowed becomes true, evidenceSummary must name the capture artifact, flags, scenario, exact native symbols, consumed state, mutated state, and updated docs.

battle-action.evidenceSummary: Diagnostic battle-event and formationProbe surfaces exist, but visible melee/ranged/first-action/adjacency correlation and active law-rank consumption are not proven.

committed-damage.evidenceSummary: DiffableCs and generated interop metadata identify Hex.Session.Battle.Unit.bbgw(...) with exact generated EMechType-shaped runtime method Method_Public_Virtual_Void_InterfacePublicAbstractbaObbbUnInbbUnObbbObUnique_InterfacePublicAbstractbaBoaObVobabaObInUnique_ObjectPublicCacodaCaObceObceUnique_Int32_EMechType_Boolean_Single_Boolean_0, and a June 18 read-only bridge request returned that as the only full-signature candidate. Damage event diagnostics exist, but no decomp callable ordinal was supplied in that bridge proof, and visible committed-damage ordering, final-damage semantics, death cleanup ordering, and safe mutation semantics are not proven.

construction.evidenceSummary: Live bridge metadata proves exact runtime candidates for construction UI/session/building-data surfaces, including Hex.Session.City.BhBuildingsManager.bajt(String) resolving to Method_Private_MonoBehaviourPublicStBhbuceBhInceStBhceUnique_String_PDM_0 with callable ordinal match. Displayed cost, charged cost, eligibility, build commit, resource mutation, constructed state, and active law-rank agreement are not proven.

counterattack.evidenceSummary: Live bridge metadata proves exact dxx resolver-set and ebv listener-set candidates for diagnostics, but real counterattack dispatch, actor identity, committed damage correlation, Focus/buff/restore mutation, and active law-rank consumption are not proven.

morale.evidenceSummary: Morale roll diagnostics exist, but visible extra-action/failure ordering, action queue mutation, and active law-rank consumption are not proven.

reward-result.evidenceSummary: Live bridge metadata proves exact reward queue/remove candidates and resource data mutation semantics. A June 18 read-only resolve for czy.vji(Hero,DataRewardSet) found Method_Public_Void_Hero_DataRewardSet_PDM_0 as the full-shape candidate but with callable ordinal 36, while requested decomp ordinal 37 resolved to a mismatched Void(Int32) method; reward apply therefore remains unbound. Committed reward/result source identity, idempotent grant point, and active law-rank consumption are not proven.

spell-cooldown.evidenceSummary: Live bridge metadata proves exact effective/decrement/add-if-ready/pool-shift cooldown candidates. A June 18 read-only resolve_decomp_method request for eew.bdmh(Int32) / decomp ordinal 45 rejected the shape-only generated Void(Int32) candidates: ordinal 45 resolved to Method_Private_Single_Int32_PDM_4, while generated Void(Int32) methods were ordinal mismatches. setCooldown remains unpromoted; source-prepared cooldown reductions now use repeated exact decrement calls instead of an absolute setter. Cast-gate/UI/execution synchronization and active law-rank consumption are not proven.

vision.evidenceSummary: Live bridge/static metadata proves exact fog read/init/count, map-magic add/lookup, object-scouting candidates, and MapVisionObjectDesc factory identities. June 18 read-only bridge requests resolved City(Int32), Hero(Int32), Item(Int32), Method_Public_Static_MapVisionObjectDesc_Int32_PDM_0, and Method_Public_Static_MapVisionObjectDesc_String_PDM_0 with callable ordinal matches. Object classification, native fog reveal mutation, side/rank context, map refresh, and idempotent reveal semantics are not proven.
